env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd use
logos build -o $WORK/bin/gouse$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/gouse$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ..

mkdir ws/lib
cp lib/go.mod ws/lib/go.mod
cp lib/lib.lgo ws/lib/lib.lgo
cp use/main.go ws/app/main.go
cd ws
logos build -o $WORK/bin/gows$GOEXE example.com/ccgoapp
exec $WORK/bin/gows$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ..

cd lib
logos eject -o ../libout
cd ..
exists libout/lib.go
! exists libout/lib.lgo
cd libout
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l lib.go
! stdout .
cd ..

cp use/main.go useplain/main.go
cd useplain
go build -o $WORK/bin/gouseplain$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/gouseplain$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../want.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/bin/gouseplainup$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/bin/gouseplainup$GOEXE
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ..

-- lib/go.mod --
module example.com/ccgoimp

go 1.27
-- lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Box struct {
	M map[string]int
	L []int
	A [3]int
	N int
}

func (b Box) Get(k string) int { return b.M[k] ?? 0 }

func (b *Box) Peek() int { return b.N }

type Item struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

func (i Item) Total() int {
	sum := i.N
	for _, v := range i.M {
		sum += v
	}
	return sum
}

const C = Box{M: map[string]int{"a": 13, "b": 2, "c": 3}, L: []int{1, 2, 3}, A: [3]int{4, 5, 6}, N: 73}

const Items = []Item{{M: map[string]int{"x": 1, "y": 2}, N: 5}, {M: map[string]int{"z": 9}, N: 6}}
-- use/go.mod --
module example.com/ccgouse

go 1.27

require example.com/ccgoimp v0.0.0

replace example.com/ccgoimp => ../lib
-- use/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"maps"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	"example.com/ccgoimp"
)

func fail(name string, got, want any) {
	fmt.Println("FAIL", name+":", "got", got, "want", want)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func check(name string, got, want any) {
	if fmt.Sprint(got) != fmt.Sprint(want) {
		fail(name, got, want)
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

func keys(m map[string]int) string {
	var parts []string
	for _, k := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(m)) {
		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprint(k, m[k]))
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, ";")
}

func main() {
	var c lib.Box = lib.C
	var items []lib.Item = lib.Items
	check("field", lib.C.N, 73)
	check("field-copy", c.N, 73)
	check("slice-field", lib.C.L[1], 2)
	check("array-field", lib.C.A[2], 6)
	v, ok := lib.C.M["a"]
	check("map-read", fmt.Sprint(v, ok), "13 true")
	_, ok = lib.C.M["z"]
	check("map-miss", ok, false)
	check("len", len(lib.C.M), 3)
	check("range", keys(lib.C.M), "a13;b2;c3")
	check("method", lib.C.Get("b"), 2)
	check("pointer-method", lib.C.Peek(), 73)
	check("items-len", len(lib.Items), 2)
	check("items-field", lib.Items[1].N, 6)
	check("items-map", lib.Items[0].M["y"], 2)
	check("items-range", keys(lib.Items[0].M), "x1;y2")
	check("items-method", lib.Items[1].Total(), 15)
	check("items-var", items[0].Total(), 8)
	i := 1
	check("items-var-index", keys(lib.Items[i].M), "z9")
}
